title: Subsets
statement_md:
Given an integer array `nums` of **unique** elements, return all possible subsets (the power set).

The solution set **must not** contain duplicate subsets. Return the solution in any order.

hints.text: For every element, you either include it in current subset or exclude it.
Backtracking: backtrack(start_index, current_path). Add a copy of current_path at each decision step.

editorial_md:
### Optimal Approach: Cascading Backtracking
At each index, branch into choice: include element or skip to next index.
- **Time Complexity:** $O(n \cdot 2^n)$
- **Space Complexity:** $O(n)$ call stack depth
